scenes.stage_direction: Phone contact becomes tangible. Let Amara listen before David interprets what the new evidence means.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The sound and the recorded delivery agree. This was recent.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: For once I can listen without guessing which day I am hearing.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The carer has also received an instruction to move him.

metadata.evidence_summary: Recent proof of life is independently supported.
